style_reference.authority: rendering style, material texture, outline, and lighting only

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular bitmap source board for a high-quality 2D strategy-game cargo attachment system
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its compact painterly pixel-cluster rendering, warm upper-left lighting, readable material texture, dark selective outline, and limited-color game-sprite finish. Do not copy or reproduce the crate.
Primary request: create exactly nine separate small medieval resource payload clusters arranged in a strict 3 by 3 grid, in this exact reading order from left to right and top to bottom: (1) three tied wood logs, (2) angular gray stone chunks, (3) red food produce with a small bread loaf, (4) a small gold coin pouch with visible coins, (5) blue-gray iron ore chunks, (6) a tied golden wheat sheaf, (7) a cream flour sack with a dark blue tie, (8) three cut wooden planks, (9) a compact blacksmith tool bundle with hammer and tongs.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for local background removal. No floor plane.
Style/medium: compact painterly pixel-art game sprites with crisp clustered pixels and controlled shading; high material readability when reduced to roughly 8-14 pixels tall; comparable to classic premium 2D strategy-game resource art, not smooth concept art.
Composition/framing: square source board; nine equal invisible cells; one payload centered in each cell; equal apparent scale; generous empty gutter between every payload; every payload fully visible and disconnected from every other payload.
Lighting/mood: one consistent warm upper-left key light with a restrained lower-right shade, matching Image 1.
Constraints: payload contents only; no crate, basket, chest, shelf, character, hands, ground, labels, letters, numbers, panel borders, UI, watermark, shadow, reflection, gradients, texture, or lighting variation in the magenta background; never use #ff00ff inside a payload.
Avoid: duplicated payloads, extra objects, touching cells, mixed viewpoints, photorealism, vector-flat icons, smooth airbrushing, blurry edges, thick black cartoon outlines.
Output intent: the nine cells will be cropped deterministically into project-bound source parts, keyed to transparency, palette-bounded, socketed into an existing carried crate, and compiled into exact-resolution runtime atlases.

background_removal.method: local chroma distance with soft edge preservation

crop_authority.trim: alpha >= 18 bounding box within each declared cell
